Page 216 Cont.
June 15 Geraldine Formez - 19 - planing on marrying out of the church because - friend refuses to sign .....
Anna Louise Kraemer - 22 - somewhat abnormal - can speak very little George Ostin - 7 - very peculiar nose - bleeds ..... said to bleed under skin.
Wm. Reichenbach - 20mo. - blood tuomer - Father once a year to Com'n.
Page 217
June Gilbert Neph - 30 - in dangerous company .... neglecting his children & convert wife.
Allen McDonald - 38 - drinks-neglects Sacraments.
June 20
Albertine Godard - 39 - Pansey Bettie Sample - 14 - Spine curv. Mrs. Mary Dorsy - 45 - Philadelphia - mind lost Dr. Eugene Robb - about 50 - cancer feared. Richard Ireland again - 3%
21 Thanks - Mrs. Agnes Pontious - 58 - was in Prov. Hospital expecting fearful operation last Tuesday - day before yesterday. No operation. Friday supposed to have operation Same day Friday comes Okay.
Anna Marie Cyr - about 35 - has house for rent at 6438 Venice Ave. Temple
22 John Gramer - 52 - lost leg 40 yrs. ago. Got along fairly well with crutch. Now arm is threatened ... Enrolled To-day.
Page 218 June 22 Sam. Scola - 25 - mental 12 yrs. in Eloise. . . Angeline Randzo - quite Deaf & Dumb
23 Richard Ireland - 3'2 - (See May 12 - June 15) .. . Now running around as- tonish parents and all by his Vitality and pep - climbs into his crib without help. Deo Gr.
